Aapka stop-loss sahi tha. Par aapne use neeche khiska diya. Phir se.
Share ₹100 pe liya, stop-loss ₹95 pe lagaya. Plan perfect.
Price ₹96 aaya, aur dimaag bola, thoda aur wait karte hain.
₹5 ka chhota loss, ab ₹20 ka bada loss ban gaya.
Ise loss aversion kehte hain: loss maanna, loss se bhi zyada dard deta hai.
Aur 20% loss ke baad, wapas aane ke liye 25% chahiye. 50% loss pe? Poora 100%.
SEBI ki FY26 study: F&O mein kareeb 88% individual traders ne paisa gawaya.
Toh rule simple hai: stop-loss trade se pehle likho, aur use sirf upar khiskao, kabhi neeche nahi.
Chhota loss lena, game mein bane rehne ki fees hai.
